NEW pose is a friendly restaurant HOST standing freely, NOT stirring or leaning behind a worktable. NO worktable, pots, spoon, furniture or food. Front-facing with a tiny turn toward viewer RIGHT; two paws relaxed by sides, gentle welcoming smile. Canvas1024x1024, grid1x1. Exact permanent model anchors: foot midpoint X=480, foot baselineY=880; hat topY=120; hat-to-feet height760; skull width350px measured across fur excluding ears; head height300px excluding hat; torso from neckY490 to trouser hemY820 about330px. Runtime whole padded canvas approximately220px portrait/340pxdesktop; detailed2px pixel clusters and2-3px warm brown selective contours, no heavy black sticker outline. Match restaurant fine pixel texture and upper-left warm daylight. Pure solid magenta#FF00FF background; no shadow, ground, labels, gridlines or extra props. PRODUCTION CONSISTENCY CONTRACT (applies to every asset): Declare exact output canvas dimensions, equal cell dimensions when using a sprite grid, intended in-scene footprint, fixed projection/camera, light direction, pixel-cluster density and outline weight matching the scene reference. For animated subjects, lock the same model sheet across ALL actions: constant skull width, head-to-body ratio, torso length, costume seams, foot spacing and ground-contact baseline. First and last neutral poses must match the canonical idle geometry. Frame bounding boxes may grow only for moving limbs/props, NEVER enlarge or shrink the whole body to fill a cell. Use one common padded canvas; reserve at least 8 percent margins around the widest action, never crop ears/tail/furniture. No per-frame zoom, reframing, translation of a copied pose, squash/stretch, or automatic tight framing. Fixed props and furniture remain the same size and at the same anchors throughout. Define body height, head width, foot-center X and foot baseline Y numerically in each animation task. For scenes/UI/items, explicitly preserve aspect ratio, safe area, optical size, border thickness and reference pixel density across variants. Backgrounds fill all edges; UI nine-slice corners remain fixed; no baked-in labels or text. Inspect transition between idle and interaction, NOT just individual sheets. Size/anchor/style mismatch means reject and regenerate; a successful HTTP response is not visual approval. For visitors entering or leaving a scene, create an explicit approach/peek/emerge/settle sequence and a physically occluded exit. Start and end the complete loop in the SAME hidden state. Specify separate entry and exit directions: never replace entrance with reversed exit, fading, scaling, or a cut from invisible to a fully visible idle character. Validate the loop boundary as carefully as individual frames.
